phase: 7 -- the official destination-marketing rosters, measured before being trusted
the_bureau_was_measured: Visit Seattle is WordPress (no Simpleview token, 404): its own accommodations category archive names every accommodation member and each member page states its premises. Visit Bellevue is a Simpleview install read through its own public listings endpoint with an EMPTY filter, honouring its Crawl-delay of 2 seconds. Seattle Southside is a Craft directory of every kind of partner, preselected by lodging slug.
the_category_filter_is_read_not_trusted: Simpleview partners are pulled UNFILTERED and each partner's OWN categories are read, because a directory's category filter may be INERT.
a_roster_row_is_not_a_policy: Tier-3 IDENTITY and ROUTING evidence. The bureau's category PROPOSES that a partner is lodging; the property's own page decides what it is. No roster row carries a pet policy.
the_bureau_does_not_decide_membership: Admission is the property's OWN postal code against the corridor registry and nothing else.

bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.experiencewa.com: state tourism -- not a lodging partner roster
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visitseattle.org Simpleview endpoints: get_simple_token and the listings endpoint answer 404 -- not Simpleview
